changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard capitalization (RoBERTa instead of Roberta) and removed redundant descriptions. The paper focuses on MT evaluation but mentions Image Captioning as an application area.

Added traditional metrics mentioned in the paper (BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE, CIDER, moverscore) and normalized metric names to base forms. The paper proposes SentSim as a combination of SSS with other metrics.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges. It uses pre-trained embeddings (RoBERTa, XLM-RoBERTa) for automatic metric computation, but not for post-generation evaluation by LLMs.

guideline: Human scores (0-100) were used as the ground-truth reference for evaluating the correlation of automatic metrics with perceived translation quality

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated the human evaluation guideline description. The paper uses human judgments as ground truth but does not specify explicit evaluation criteria beyond overall translation quality.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating machine translation quality using automatic metrics. It proposes SentSim, which combines sentence-level (SSS) and token-level (WMD, BERTScore) semantic similarity metrics. The extraction was generally accurate but missed some traditional metrics mentioned in the related work. The paper uses human judgments as ground truth but doesn't specify detailed evaluation criteria.
